title: Wonderful Granada Tour
text: It was a wonderful tour and Laura was a very knowledgeable tour guide.  She was also a lot of fun.  The actual Cathedral was unfortunately closed due to a recent earthquake but Laura more than made up for that by expanding our tour around the area.  My husband and I learned so much and the Royal Chapel was stunning!  Highly recommend this tour!  Thank you, Laura.
author: Robin0313

title: Excellent historical visit
text: Magnificent experience. Mercedes, our guide, was very attentive, as well as very knowledgeable and cultured. The visit to the Royal Chapel is especially interesting, but the guide provides historical context from the very first meeting point at Isabel la Católica Square.
author: gcavazosv

title: Good value for mone
text: Our tour guide was very good. Helpful and knowledgeable. We hit more pints of interest than I thought - bonus!

title: Excellent tour!
text: Estefania, our tour guide, was outstanding.  She explained everything in detail and in a clear manner.  My wife and I enjoyed this tour very much.
author: CarlosAntonio_F

title: Marvels of History, Architecture and Art.
text: The Cathedral and Royal Chapel were both Architectural marvels filled with history. Our guide Irene was an expert of both the history and art of these monuments as well as Granada and Spain! She was great.
author: Darion_M

title: Great history of Granada and how the church was created in spain
text: Very good tour.  Great history of the Catholic influence of Spain rather than just the splendor of the cathedral.  The presentation was plainly secular given the history, art and architecture presented, which it should be.  I did enjoy the history of the creation of the cathedral and intrigued by the politics behind it all.
